# Download Manager

> Free, open source download manager software for Windows 10 and 11. Multithreaded downloads, video downloads, queues, a scheduler and a Chrome extension. Based on Persepolis Download Manager, released under GPLv3.

## Product

- [Download](https://sourceforge.net/projects/download-manager/): Download from the SourceForge project page
- [Source code](https://github.com/MoatChuninFigure/download-manager-for-pc): GitHub repository
